te: Assassination of Conrad of Montferrat (Conrad I), King of Jerusalem, in Tyre, two days after his title to the throne is…
dz: 刺杀耶路撒冷国王蒙费拉特(英语:Conrad I)的康拉德(英语:Conferrat (Conrad I))于提尔,即其王位头衔被选举确认后两天. 杀戮由哈什沙申进行.
de: Assassination of Conrad of Montferrat (Conrad I), King of Jerusalem, in Tyre, two days after his title to the throne is confirmed by election. The killing is carried out by Hashshashin.

t: 耶路撒冷女王伊莎贝拉一世与香槟伯爵亨利二世结婚.
te: Queen Isabella I of Jerusalem marries Henry II, Count of Champagne.
dz: 耶路撒冷女王伊莎贝拉一世与香槟伯爵亨利二世结婚.
de: Queen Isabella I of Jerusalem marries Henry II, Count of Champagne.

t: 英格兰的理查一世在雅法之战中击败了萨拉丁,这使得他得以为十字军缔结有利的条约.
te: Richard I of England defeats Saladin in the battle of Jaffa, which enables him to conclude a favourable treaty for the …
dz: 英格兰的理查一世在雅法之战中击败了萨拉丁,这使得他得以为十字军缔结有利的条约.
de: Richard I of England defeats Saladin in the battle of Jaffa, which enables him to conclude a favourable treaty for the crusaders.

t: 源赖朝成为圣伊大将军，成为日本事实上的统治者。按照日本传统历法，这一天是建久三年七月十二日。
te: Minamoto no Yoritomo becomes Sei-i Taishōgun and the de facto ruler of Japan. Under the traditional Japanese calendar, …
dz: 源赖朝成为圣伊大将军，成为日本事实上的统治者。按照日本传统历法，这一天是建久三年七月十二日。
de: Minamoto no Yoritomo becomes Sei-i Taishōgun and the de facto ruler of Japan. Under the traditional Japanese calendar, it was on the 12th day of the seventh month in the third year of the Kenkyū (建久) era.

t: 雅法条约由英格兰的理查一世和萨拉丁签署,导致第三次十字军东征的结束.
te: The Treaty of Jaffa is signed between Richard I of England and Saladin, leading to the end of the Third Crusade.
dz: 雅法条约由英格兰的理查一世和萨拉丁签署,导致第三次十字军东征的结束.
de: The Treaty of Jaffa is signed between Richard I of England and Saladin, leading to the end of the Third Crusade.

t: 第三次十字军东征后，英国国王理查一世在返回英国途中被奥地利国王利奥波德五世俘虏并监禁。
te: Richard I of England is captured and imprisoned by Leopold V of Austria on his way home to England after the Third Crus…
dz: 第三次十字军东征后，英国国王理查一世在返回英国途中被奥地利国王利奥波德五世俘虏并监禁。
de: Richard I of England is captured and imprisoned by Leopold V of Austria on his way home to England after the Third Crusade.
